What's new in DuckOS 1.0.85

• DuckOS speaks your language: choose German or Turkish in Settings › Languages & input and DuckOS's own apps follow at once — Settings, DuckWallet and DuckPay, Phone, Messages, Contacts, Camera, Photos, Files, DuckWeb, DuckAI, Clock, Calendar, To Do, Weather, Notes, the games and DuckMaps — along with every other app. In other languages, DuckOS's own words stay in English for now.
• DuckMaps gives directions in your language, and says street names the way the country says them: on an English phone in Germany you hear "turn left onto" in English and "Hauptstraße" in German.
